title: Browser game (HTML5 canvas)
description: Complete canvas arcade game with no dependencies: game loop with delta time, keyboard/touch input, menu/playing/paused/game-over states, levels, lives and a saved high score.
produces: Game playable in any browser; deployable to itch.io, GitHub Pages or any static host
run: Or serve it: cd __APP_NAME__ && python3 -m http.server 8080, then open http://localhost:8080
build: No build step: zip the folder for itch.io (HTML game) or deploy it to any static host.
customize: game.js CONFIG: canvas size, speeds, spawn rates, lives
game.js Player / Hazard / Pickup classes: entity behaviour and drawing
game.js update(dt): rules, collisions and scoring; render(): all drawing
Swap the vector drawing in each draw() for sprites via ctx.drawImage when adding art
